GATE = no NEW high/critical fingerprint vs this baseline.

every new keeper detector retroactively surfaces old debt and would otherwise red CI.

backticked 'patches our own symbol `X`' token when present, else the issue text's
first 80 chars with digits replaced by '#' (line-number-churn robust).

from BOTH this baseline and the live comparison so the gate cannot flap):

- 'Dispatcher'    dispatcher-staleness (date-relative)

HOW TO REFRESH (deterministic, regenerable — run from repo root):
mcp/noctusai/.venv/bin/python mcp/noctusai/tests/refresh_compliance_baseline.py
Refresh ONLY when a high/critical issue is intentionally RESOLVED (baseline shrinks)
or a NEW pre-existing class is triaged-and-accepted (never to silence a regression).
A refresh that GROWS the baseline must cite the triage decision in the commit msg.
